about: Every place the mod touches Balatro. Only one lovely patch (a copy-append to main.lua); everything else wraps a Balatro function at runtime, so a game update that moves code around can't break a pattern match.

rows.purpose: Load the mod's Lua after all game files, before love.load runs
Add hero Jokers and the Expedition Deck to G.P_CENTERS and their pools
Add names and descriptions before Balatro parses them
Build the hero atlas from Darkest Dungeon portraits
Show a hero's portrait (and afflicted/virtuous frame)
Mark which hero's tooltip is being built
Fill the hero tooltip numbers (stat, Stress, state)
Expedition Deck hands out the party at run start
